lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming approximately five horizontal rows extending from the posterior branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows at near-perpendicular angles, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper lateral flank defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and lower values in the ventral shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a discrete cluster of high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface, primarily concentrated in the anterior and central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a small notch on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin; multiple faint linear markings of high luminance on the dorsal surface posterior to the first dorsal fin.
